newsitem.title: USA: Gen Signal "optimistic" on meeting 97 view.
newsitem.headline: Gen Signal "optimistic" on meeting 97 view.

text.p: General Signal Corp said Wednesday it remains optimistic that earnings will be consistent with Wall Street expectations this year.
Analayst forecast the company will report $0.71 per share for Q2, $0.81 per share for Q3, $0.95 per share for Q4 and $2.93 for the year, according to First Call.
The company said it has "taken actions to improve our operating results."
Also Wednesday, General Signal reported earnings of $0.47 per share, down from $0.51 per share reported in Q1 1996.
